pipeline.note: Directional blur confirmed on all 5 supports: identify_blur_type=MOTION_BLUR 5/5 (PCA 2.553/3.380/2.527/2.341/3.345; PCA>2.5 = 0% FP signal, exp28 calibration). Isotropic families rejected at their untested max severity: gaussian:5 25.58 dB, lens:5 25.60 dB (deterministic, below same-session control 26.32 dB). Severity 4 retained: R0 pair0 signal spectral_slope diff sev4=0.166 < sev5=0.183; gm_ratio per pair 0.319-0.657 (sev estimate 2-5, noisy/content-dependent, mode=4). UNCERTAIN because blur_motion draws angle=uniform(-90,90) per application, so the target's actual angle is unrepresentable and pixel PSNR is not reproducible (identical-pipeline repeats on pair0: 22.02/26.32/32.54 dB).

JPEG confirmed on all 5 supports (block_boundary 1.591-2.428 >> 1.1, 0% FP; dct_zero_ratio 0.79-0.97; unique_G 222-256). Severity revised 1->2 (q25->q18): at jpeg:1 the block_boundary mismatch on supports 1-4 was 10-15% and was treated by R0 as an acceptable near-miss; at jpeg:2 block_boundary matched 5/5. Pair1 bracketing with two independent random motion angles per level: jpeg:1 13% and 15% (mismatch), jpeg:2 <8% both times (match), jpeg:3 32% (overshoot) -> target blockiness corresponds to a quality between q25 and q12, closest to q18. Combined PSNR pair0 27.35 dB (CI 9/10) vs control 26.32 dB (CI 7/10) same session; R0 jpeg:2 sample 26.86 dB (CI 10/10).

analysis.mode: SIGNAL-primary (noise_prior sigma=0.74 < 2 so PSNR would nominally be allowed, but blur_motion re-samples angle per application -> pixel PSNR not reproducible: identical-pipeline repeats on pair0 span 22.02-32.54 dB, 10.52 dB). PSNR kept as descriptive secondary evidence.
analysis.support_validation: pairs 0-4, verify_signals via test_candidate. C2 blur_motion:4+compression_jpeg:2: pair0 WEAK (bb match; slope diff 0.135; wiener 0.326), pair1 MATCH (slope+bb+wiener), pair1 repeat PARTIAL (slope+bb match; wiener 0.282), pair2 PARTIAL (slope+bb match; wiener 0.236), pair3 PARTIAL (slope+bb match; wiener 0.371), pair4 PARTIAL (slope+bb match; wiener 0.196). Control jpeg:1: pair0 WEAK (bb match; slope 0.166), pair1 WEAK (slope match; bb 13%, repeat 15%), pair2 WEAK (slope; bb 10%), pair3 MISMATCH (slope 0.121; bb 12%), pair4 PARTIAL (slope+bb; wiener 0.207). Compression block_boundary: control 2/5 -> C2 5/5. Spectral_slope: 4/5 both (pair3 fixed 0.121->match; pair0 0.166->0.135). Verdict level: improved 3/5 (pair1 WEAK->MATCH, pair2 WEAK->PARTIAL, pair3 MISMATCH->PARTIAL), unchanged 2/5, worse 0/5. PSNR pair0: 27.35 (C2) vs 26.32 (control) = +1.03 dB, CI 7/10->9/10.
analysis.rationale: Two-step blur->JPEG pipeline (physical order). R0's pipeline family and motion severity are confirmed by reanalysis of all 5 supports, but R0 chose JPEG severity 1 on a PSNR tie (23.81 vs 23.91) and dismissed a systematic block_boundary near-miss on supports 1-4 as 'quality=25 is the mildest level available'. Re-bracketing shows the target blockiness is not at q25: two independent angles at jpeg:1 are 13%/15% below tolerance, two at jpeg:2 match, and jpeg:3 overshoots by 32%; severity 2 is the unique best available level. The compression claim is a deterministic, 0%-FP signal, holds on 5/5 supports, and no support pair regressed on any pipeline-controllable signal (bb/slope). The only unfixable mismatch is the Wiener-kernel correlation, which is angle-dependent by construction for re-sampled motion and therefore never matches across supports. Noise is ruled out by an order of magnitude (any noise_* severity 1 adds sigma ~12.75 in 0-255 scale vs measured 0.74-1.85). No global step on 5/5 (contrast_spread_ratio 0.885-0.975, mean_shift -0.2..-0.5, chroma_ratio 0.92-1.03). glass_score 0.48-1.04 is far above the calibrated glass(2-4) range 0.19-0.41 and is inflated by JPEG blockiness; glass:3 simulated only 22.76 dB, so glass is rejected. Overall UNCERTAIN remains solely because the motion angle is not a pipeline parameter.

deterministic_family_ceiling.note: untested max severities of isotropic families; deterministic so PSNR is directly comparable; both below control 26.32 -> directional blur confirmed

noise_6step_check.diagnosis: NO_NOISE. Any noise_* severity 1 adds sigma ~12.75 (0.05*255); observed 0.74-1.85 is an order of magnitude below. run_full_analysis's low-confidence GAUSSIAN_YCrCb verdicts and the peeled extreme_pct=50.07 / spatial_corr=0.9933 are structured residual artifacts (motion-angle mismatch + JPEG), the SKILL-documented false-positive pattern.
